This notebook summarises the study cohort: the number of crypts, biopsies and
donors included; their clinical and demographic breakdown; sequencing summary
statistics; and the cohort overview heatmap (Figure 1a).

## Setup

### Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)        # dplyr, stringr, tibble, ggplot2, ...
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```

### Input data

```{r load-data}
crypt_metadata <- read.csv("../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv")
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv("../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv")
```

`biopsy_metadata.csv` holds one row per crypt with the associated biopsy,
donor and clinical annotations. `crypt_signature_attributions.csv` holds one
row per crypt with sequencing coverage and mutational burden.

## Study participants

### Crypts, biopsies and donors

```{r cohort-totals}
crypts_included   <- nrow(crypt_signature_attributions)
biopsies_included <- n_distinct(crypt_metadata$biopsy)
donors_included   <- n_distinct(crypt_metadata$patient)

cat(
  sprintf("Crypts included:   %d\n", crypts_included),   # n = 989 crypts
  sprintf("Biopsies included: %d\n", biopsies_included), # n = 152 biopsies
  sprintf("Patients included: %d\n", donors_included),   # n = 90 individuals
  sep = ""
)
```

### Breakdown by cohort

```{r cohort-breakdown}
cohort_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient), .groups = "drop")

cohort_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy), .groups = "drop")

left_join(cohort_patients, cohort_biopsies, by = "cohort")
```

### Breakdown by nationality

```{r nationality-breakdown}
# Expected: Denmark = 17 | UK = 73
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, nationality) %>%
  count(nationality, name = "patients")
```

### Breakdown by IBD subtype

```{r ibd-breakdown}
ibd_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_results) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient), .groups = "drop")

ibd_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_results) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy), .groups = "drop")

left_join(ibd_patients, ibd_biopsies, by = "colonoscopy_results")
```

### Treatment among individuals with IBD

```{r ibd-treatment}
crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD", treatment != "Nil") %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient), .groups = "drop")
```

### Histologically normal individuals

```{r histologically-normal}
histologically_normal_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_finding) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient), .groups = "drop")

histologically_normal_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_finding) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy), .groups = "drop")

histologically_normal_summary <- left_join(
  histologically_normal_patients,
  histologically_normal_biopsies,
  by = "colonoscopy_finding"
)
```

Totals:

```{r histologically-normal-totals}
cat(
  sprintf("Histologically normal donors:   %d\n", sum(histologically_normal_summary$patients)),
  sprintf("Histologically normal biopsies: %d\n", sum(histologically_normal_summary$biopsies)),
  sep = ""
)
```

Breakdown by colonoscopy finding:

```{r histologically-normal-summary}
histologically_normal_summary
```

### Biopsies by anatomical location

```{r biopsies-by-location}
crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy), .groups = "drop")
```

### Biopsies per donor

```{r biopsies-per-donor}
crypt_metadata %>%
  count(nationality, patient, name = "biopsies_per_donor") %>%
  count(nationality, biopsies_per_donor, name = "n_donors")
```

### Age and sex

```{r age-summary}
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, age) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = round(median(age, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1),
    min_age    = round(min(age, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1),
    max_age    = round(max(age, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 1)
  )
```

```{r sex-summary}
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, sex) %>%
  count(sex, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count) * 100)
```

## Coverage and sequencing statistics

```{r sequencing-stats}
median_cov   <- median(crypt_signature_attributions$coverage, na.rm = TRUE)
total_snvs   <- sum(as.numeric(crypt_signature_attributions$snv_total_burden), na.rm = TRUE)
total_indels <- sum(as.numeric(crypt_signature_attributions$indel_total_burden), na.rm = TRUE)

cat(
  sprintf("Median coverage: %s\n", format(median_cov, big.mark = ",")),
  sprintf("Total SNVs:      %s\n", format(total_snvs, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)),
  sprintf("Total indels:    %s\n", format(total_indels, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)),
  sep = ""
)
```

## Cohort overview heatmap

### Per-patient annotation table

One row per patient, ordered by age, with diagnosis labels collapsed into the
categories used in the figure legend.

```{r heatmap-metadata}
patient_heatmap_metadata <- crypt_metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient, age, sex, nationality,
    colonoscopy_indication, colonoscopy_results, treatment
  ) %>%
  distinct(patient, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    colonoscopy_results = case_when(
      str_detect(colonoscopy_results, "IBDUnclassified") ~ "IBD Unclassified",
      colonoscopy_results %in% c(
        "CD", "UC", "FAP", "Histologically_Normal",
        "Lymphocytic gastritis", "Juvenile Polyp"
      ) ~ colonoscopy_results,
      # Aggregate threadworm and other infections for simplicity
      colonoscopy_results %in% c("Threadworm", "Infection") ~ "Infection",
      .default = "Other"
    ),
    # Expand abbreviations to their full names for the figure legend
    colonoscopy_results = str_replace(colonoscopy_results, "UC", "Ulcerative Colitis"),
    colonoscopy_results = str_replace(colonoscopy_results, "CD", "Crohn's Disease"),
    colonoscopy_results = str_replace(colonoscopy_results, "Histologically_Normal", "Normal"),
    colonoscopy_results = str_replace(colonoscopy_results, "FAP", "Familial Adenomatous Polyposis"),
    colonoscopy_results = str_replace(colonoscopy_results, "IBD", "Inflammatory Bowel Disease"),
    
    colonoscopy_indication = case_when(colonoscopy_indication%in%c('Obstipation',"Irritable Bowel Syndrome","Functional abdominal pain","Unknown")~'Other',
                                     colonoscopy_indication%in%c("New IBD Diagnosis","Follow Up IBD Diagnosis")~'Evaluation of Inflammatory Bowel Disease', 
                                     colonoscopy_indication=='Ab Pain / Exclude IBD'~"Evaluation of Abdominal Pain",
                                     colonoscopy_indication=='Painless PR Bleeding'~"Evaluation of Painless Per Rectum Bleeding",
                                     
                                     is.na(colonoscopy_indication)~'Other',
                                     .default = colonoscopy_indication)
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "patient") %>%
  arrange(age) %>%
  mutate(across(!starts_with("age"), ~ factor(.x)))
```

### Annotation object

```{r heatmap-annotation}
result_levels <- c(
  "Normal",
  "Infection",
  "Juvenile Polyp",
  "Lymphocytic gastritis",
  "Familial Adenomatous Polyposis",
  "Crohn's Disease",
  "Inflammatory Bowel Disease Unclassified",
  "Ulcerative Colitis",
  "Other"
)

indication_levels=c(
  "Evaluation of Painless Per Rectum Bleeding",
  "Evaluation of Inflammatory Bowel Disease",
  "Evaluation of Abdominal Pain",
  "Lymphocytic gastritis",
  "Juvenile Polyp",
  "Infection",
  "Other"
  
)
age_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  range(patient_heatmap_metadata$age, na.rm = TRUE),
  c("ivory2", "red4")
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Age                      = patient_heatmap_metadata$age,
  Sex                      = patient_heatmap_metadata$sex,
  Nationality              = patient_heatmap_metadata$nationality,
  `Colonoscopy Indication` = factor(patient_heatmap_metadata$colonoscopy_indication, levels = indication_levels),
  `Colonoscopy Results`    = factor(patient_heatmap_metadata$colonoscopy_results, levels = result_levels),
  col = list(
    Age         = age_col_fun,
    Sex         = c("Male" = "darkslateblue", "Female" = "#f3b255ff", "NA" = "grey90"),
    Nationality = c("UK" = "orchid4", "Denmark" = "palevioletred"),
    
   `Colonoscopy Indication` = c(
    "Evaluation of Painless Per Rectum Bleeding" ='darkolivegreen4',
    "Evaluation of Inflammatory Bowel Disease"     ='burlywood4',
    "Evaluation of Abdominal Pain" = "plum4",
    "Lymphocytic gastritis"='lightsalmon',
    "Juvenile Polpy"  ='pink3',
    "Infection"='lightskyblue4',
    "Other"='grey90'),
    
    `Colonoscopy Results` = c(
      "Normal"                                  = "darkolivegreen4",
      "Infection"                               = "lightskyblue4",
      "Familial Adenomatous Polyposis"          = "firebrick4",
      "Juvenile Polyp"                          = "pink3",
      "Lymphocytic gastritis"                   = "lightsalmon",
      "Inflammatory Bowel Disease Unclassified" = "burlywood3",
      "Crohn's Disease"                         = "tan4",
      "Ulcerative Colitis"                      = "wheat2",
      "Other"                                   = "grey90"
    )
  ),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold")
)
```

### Draw and export

```{r heatmap-plot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4}
n_patients <- nrow(patient_heatmap_metadata)

cohort_heatmap <- Heatmap(
  matrix(1, nrow = 0, ncol = n_patients),
  top_annotation      = ha,
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE
)

draw(cohort_heatmap, annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
```

```{r heatmap-export, results = "hide"}
dir.create("../Figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

svg("../Figures/childhood_colon_metadata.svg", width = 12, height = 4, bg = "transparent")
draw(cohort_heatmap, annotation_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
```
